name: Pokemon Stadium 2 Overworld Models - Gold/Silver (Gen 2)
description: Standalone Gold/Silver Gen-2 voxel + Stadium 2 mod. v0.1.90 keeps the lean Gen-2-only package and makes the live overworld battle presentation explicitly optional in Mod Settings: LIVE OVERWORLD BATTLES defaults ON, while OFF returns ordinary wild battles to Gold's classic battle scene. Retains the v0.1.89 live encounter-world compositor, v0.1.88 Gold GBC voxel color, lead-party follower, weather, camera modes, Johto tree geometry, Stadium 2 overworld models, Skin Selector compatibility, and visible START/pause overlays.
